 \entrybig
	{\textbf{Modelling Disease Transmission in Networks}}{Jan - Feb 2025}
        {\textit{with Prof. Chaitanya Gokhale at University of Wurzburg}}{}
        {Modelling disease transmission across networks to understand how different social interactions modulate the spread and suppression of disease in the ant colony.}{}

\entrybig
        {\textbf{Reinforcement-induced reduction of number of INs in Zebra Finches}}{Spring 2023}
	{\textit{with Dr. Raghav Rajan at IISER Pune (\href{https://drive.google.com/file/d/10DWXAQBypKDp8948ZgC0VauIE3F8S00O/view?usp=sharing}{\textcolor{blue}{Report}}})}{}
        {I conducted a closed-loop behavioural assay using syllable variance measured in real-time to provide negative reinforcement against a high number of introductory note syllables (INs). We saw a significant reduction in the mean number of INs in a test bird.}{}

\entrybig
        {\textbf{Comparative Analysis of Introductory Notes across Four Estrildid bird species}}{Fall 2022}
        {\textit{with Dr. Raghav Rajan and Nandu T. S. at IISER Pune (\href{https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UBd7h5-iWQgIqOsWF9z3fjjDxa7OYgFE/view?usp=sharing}{\textcolor{blue}{Report}})}}{}
        {We compared the song sequences of four Estrildid species using audio recordings and found that the progression of initial syllables in the song is similar to the introductory notes of Zebra finches.}{}

 \entrybig
        {\textbf{Effect of Recent Pathogen Experience on Sanitary Brood Care in Ants}}{Summer 2022}
        {\textit{with Prof. Sylvia Cremer and L. Sartoris at the IST Austria (\href{https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XCwEGtxHZkLMuvcElv6Uf5ji1oZMi6Mg/view?usp=sharing}{\textcolor{blue}{Report}})}}{}
        {We exposed ants to a fungal pathogen for a brief period and later to contaminated larvae, to test if recent pathogen experience modulates grooming behaviour, but we didn't find any effect.}{}
